accept_team_invitation.description: Join a team with an invitation link (or its token) the person was given. Email-bound invitations must be accepted in the Chaos app with the verified address. Only when the person asks to join.

add_course_lesson.description: Create a blank owned lesson draft at the end of an owned course (maximum 100 lessons). Edit with existing lesson tools. Does not publish. Do not automatically retry uncertain success.

add_folder_member.description: Idempotently add an owned form, quiz, lesson, active source or collection to an owned folder. Does not change asset sharing or return source bytes.

add_lesson_blocks.title: Append lesson blocks
add_lesson_blocks.description: Append complete Chaos blocks to a draft with a mandatory revision check. New IDs must be unique and stable. No publication. Use move_lesson_blocks afterwards to position them, or edit_lesson_blocks for an atomic append-and-move batch.

advance_game.title: Advance a live game one step
advance_game.description: Host-only, Pro: lobby → first question → reveal → leaderboard → next question (or end). Use from and questionIndex from get_game. Starting needs a joined player; advancing from question closes it early and reveals answers to the room. Act only on the host's explicit request. A retry with the same from/index is harmless; stale state does not advance. No answer keys are returned.

nextStepAt.description: When autoplay moves on (ms since epoch); null when paused or not on an answer/leaderboard screen.

startsAt.description: When the lobby countdown ends and the first question starts.

attach_lesson_flashcards.description: Attach a published flashcard version to an owned lesson so learners can study it there (at most 50 per lesson). Use versionId from publish_flashcard_set or publishedVersionId from get_flashcard_set. Attaching the same set again updates its version, label and order. Does not publish the lesson.

attach_lesson_quiz.description: Attach an owned existing quiz to an owned lesson by stable identity. Quizzes are forms: pass asset {kind:"form", id} with the id create_form, create_game_draft or search_forms returned (kind "quiz" with the same id also works). Updates label/order idempotently; creates no quiz copy and never publishes.

build_study_lesson.description: Start or resume a durable study lesson job. Use for Study this PDF, teach/explain a lecture, create a tutorial, or do Lecture 8 like previous lessons. The MCP client reads the complete source (including visuals), teaches using the create-study-lesson skill, and saves resumable checkpoints. No server AI extraction is implied. Upload client-local files explicitly using upload_study_source; client upload IDs and local paths are not backend files. Course/module titles resolve only unambiguous existing matches. Draft by default; returned profile may authorize publication. Reuse a stable key for retries.

change_form_collaborator.description: Explicit owner-authorized invitation, role change or removal (role=null). Grants access to form and respondent data; may notify an existing Chaos account. Obtain clear user intent identifying recipient and role before calling. Requires current membershipRevision from list_form_collaborators; reload on conflict or uncertain success. Cannot transfer or remove ownership. Requires authenticated Chaos MCP OAuth access.

change_team_member_role.description: Change a member's role. Only the owner assigns admins; role owner transfers ownership and makes the current owner an admin. Only on explicit request.

teamId.description: A Business team ID from list_teams.

checkpoint_study_lesson.description: Save or replace one bounded teaching checkpoint (210 KB maximum). Stable key + identical value is safe to retry, even with an old revision. Otherwise use latest expectedRevision. Reading is a client attestation of complete page/slide/section and visual inspection, never automatic extraction. Section concepts use local descriptive names; block conceptIds must be real Chaos concept IDs or empty. Record original source questions first, then independently solve with citations. Original IDs, wording, options, attribution and order must survive unchanged. Supplementary questions omit originalId. Review records client-verified diagrams/media and warnings. No publication.

create_course.description: Create an empty owned course draft to build step by step (create_full_course does everything in one call). Never publishes. Each call creates a new course; inspect the library before retrying uncertain success.

create_flashcard_set.description: Create a flashcard set with up to 500 cards (front is the prompt, back the answer) as a private draft; publish true also publishes it (public unless visibility says otherwise), only when the person explicitly asks. Returns versionId for attach_lesson_flashcards when published. Each call creates a new set; check list_flashcard_sets before retrying an uncertain success.

id.description: Stable card ID; keep existing IDs when editing.

revision.description: Current revision from get_flashcard_set; reload on conflict before retrying.

create_folder.description: Create an owned private folder, maximum depth 8. Requires ownership of parent. Each successful call creates a folder; inspect the list before retrying an uncertain success.

create_form.title: Create a form or quiz
create_form.description: Create a new form, survey or quiz as a draft in the person's Chaos library, with all its questions. For a quiz set quizMode true and give correctAnswers (exact option labels) and points on choice questions. Pass a theme (a preset name) that suits the form; the default is Lilac. Sound is on (Glass) unless you pass sound, e.g. off for formal or sensitive forms. Stays a private draft and returns the edit link. With publish true it publishes and returns the share link, unless something must be fixed first (then it stays a draft and the problems are listed).

description.description: Intro text shown at the top.

quizMode.description: true for a scored quiz with an answer key.

showAnswers.description: Quiz mode only: after submitting, respondents see which answers were right, the correct answers and the explanations (default true). false shows only their marks, for tests whose key must stay private.

presentation.description: page = all questions on one page (default); one_at_a_time = one question per screen; sections = one page per section; swipe = full-screen cards.

id.description: Keep the id from get_form when editing an existing question; omit for new questions.

type.description: single_choice = pick one; multiple_choice = checkboxes; statement = text block with no answer; section = page break.

label.description: The question text: one short, direct sentence.

description.description: Optional help text under the question. Usually leave empty.

options.description: Choices for single_choice, multiple_choice, dropdown and ranking; columns for matrix.

min.description: scale start (0 or 1), number minimum, or minimum selections/characters.

max.description: rating steps (3–10), scale end (2–10), number maximum, or maximum selections/characters.

minLabel.description: Label for the low end of a rating or scale.

maxLabel.description: Label for the high end of a rating or scale.

correctAnswers.description: Quiz mode only: the exact label(s) of the correct option(s). One for single_choice and dropdown.

points.description: Quiz mode only: points for a correct answer (default 1).

explanation.description: Quiz mode only: one plain sentence shown after answering.

theme.description: Optional look by name, e.g. Lilac (default), Banner, Paper, Evergreen, Spotlight (Typeform-like), Midnight (dark). See list_themes.

sound.description: Optional sound pack for respondents: off, soft, pop, wood, arcade (soft = Glass, the default; off = silent). Choose one that suits the form.

publish.description: Default false: create a private draft to review. Pass true only when the person explicitly asks to publish it now.

create_full_course.description: Create a whole course in one call: title, description, cover (https link or /covers/ gallery path; a random gallery cover when omitted), cover position, and up to 100 lessons in order, each with its own blocks and optional cover (each lesson gets its own random cover otherwise). Icons are not shown; leave icon out. Creates drafts by default. Only explicit publish: true publishes each lesson and then the course. Private needs Business. If something fails part-way, the result says what was created so you can continue with the course tools instead of starting again.

If publication is blocked the lesson stays a draft and problems are listed. Never changes source sharing.

Requires nonempty concept or block coverage, unique entries, concepts declared on the node and block IDs present in the current draft. Does not publish. Duplicate lesson/node mappings are rejected; inspect existing state before retrying uncertain success.

create_lesson_live_game.description: Create an existing Chaos Live game from an owned assessment linked to an owned lesson. Reuses normal publication, eligibility, rate and plan rules. Call only for explicit intent to prepare Live; each success creates a room and is not safe to retry blindly.

create_team.description: Create a Business team owned by this person. Free during the limited-time promotion; no checkout or charges. Each call creates a team, so check list_teams before retrying an uncertain success.

customize_my_card.description: Customize your own Chaos Card. showStudentCards controls your public student Card preference (off unless you turn it on), including when skipping onboarding. Only set it when the person explicitly asks. Choose name, reserved username, style 0–31, generated avatar 0–23 and optional avatarHue 0–359 (null resets to automatic). Existing public URL aliases remain valid. Only explicit finishOnboarding or skip marks first-account setup complete; edits are optional and can be changed later.

delete_lesson_blocks.title: Delete lesson blocks from draft
delete_lesson_blocks.description: Revision-protected atomic deletion of existing IDs from the draft, keeping a recovery snapshot. Remove children before parents or use edit_lesson_blocks to reparent them first. Published history stays unchanged; never publishes.

end_game.description: Host-only, Pro: stop a game immediately, prevent further play and save collected results using the existing live-game workflow. Does not delete the source quiz, collected responses or publish draft changes. Act only on an explicit request to end this room. Repeating for an ended room is harmless. Returns save status/counts, never individual responses.

export_course_manifest.description: Read the owner-only versioned course archive manifest with metadata, outcomes, modules and ordered lesson IDs. Use existing lesson/deck/quiz reads to transfer structured content. No student responses, progress or file bytes. Builder Export course.zip includes owned binary files.

export_form_responses.description: Explicitly export owned respondent data into a downloadable CSV/XLSX/JSON artifact; no response dataset is returned in model context. Download URL is a sensitive bearer link until deletion after 24 hours. Limits: 5000 included responses, 5100 scanned rows, 8 MB scanned data, 16 MB artifact. Export is paginated, not a transaction-wide snapshot; concurrent response edits may appear. Requires authenticated Chaos MCP OAuth access.

finalize_study_lesson.description: Validate complete reading, concept coverage, original question preservation, independently evidenced answers, media review, duplicate cards and course placement; then atomically save native lesson, quizzes, inline flashcards and glossary as drafts. Reuses explicitly selected matching assets. No publication; embedded draft assets become playable after authorized publication. Failures preserve checkpoints and report actionable problems. Repeated success returns the same lesson URL.

fork_lesson.title: Fork a published lesson
fork_lesson.description: Copy an accessible immutable version into a new private draft. Non-owners may copy only the current published version. Preserves parent/version/origin and citation IDs; never grants source access or publishes. Each call creates a draft; do not retry an uncertain success.

Requires explicit intent to copy assessment content.

pendingChanges.description: Draft changes readers do not see yet. details (title, description, cover, tags, level) wait for publish_course; structure (outline, modules) goes live with publish_course or the next publish_lesson of a lesson in this course.

get_course_lesson.description: Read a lesson from a readable course publication, preserving the exact immutable version in that course. Current asset restrictions still apply. Returns no response data.

get_course_progress.description: Read only your own lesson progress in a readable course's published versions. Does not disclose other students or response data.

get_flashcard_set.description: Read an owned flashcard set's editable draft: title, every card and the revision needed to save, publish or archive it. Owner only.

get_form_advanced_analytics.description: Owner-only aggregate analytics using the same Chaos UI calculations: correct rates, branching drop-off, completion times, scores, distributions and sampling caveats. Excludes individual written responses and answer keys. Requires authenticated Chaos MCP OAuth access.

get_form_response_controls.description: Read owned form response controls and their independent settings revision. Returns no access-code hash or plaintext code, respondent data or answer keys.

get_game.title: Get a hosted game
get_game.description: Get one owned live game's state, zero-based questionIndex (-1 in a lobby), timing, settings and host/join links. No questions, answer keys, participant names or individual responses are returned. Use this state before advance_game. Pro required.

host_game.description: Create a joinable lobby from the account owner's already published quiz (form_… or quiz_…). Snapshots the published questions and theme; draft changes are not used. Refuses drafts, closed/archived forms and quizzes without eligible choices/correct answers. Never publishes or starts the first question. teamId makes the game team-only: only signed-in members of that Business team can join; a team-only quiz makes its games team-only automatically. Creates a new room each call, so do not automatically retry after an uncertain response. Host only on explicit request. Pro required.

list_curriculum_institutions.description: Browse public canonical curriculum institutions. Existing active account required. Nodes and parents must belong to the selected version. No private lessons or source content.

list_curriculum_nodes.description: Browse public canonical curriculum nodes. Existing active account required. Nodes and parents must belong to the selected version. No private lessons or source content.

list_games.description: List the signed-in account's hosted game rooms, newest first, including ended rooms. Paged, at most 50 per call. Quiz drafts are found with search_forms. Returns state, settings and links; no participant names, answers, answer keys or player secrets. Pro required.

list_responses.title: Read responses
list_responses.description: Read individual completed responses (newest first), with each answer as text and quiz scores. Answers may contain personal information; use only when the person asks to read or analyse individual responses. Uploaded files are not included.

list_team_invitations.description: List open invitations for a team. Owner or admin only. Never returns invitation links.

list_team_members.description: List a team's members with names and roles. Member email addresses are not returned. Members only.

list_team_resources.description: List forms, lessons, courses and folders shared with a team. Every member can edit shared content; publishing stays with each owner.

list_teams.description: List the Business teams this person belongs to, with their role. Personal accounts have none; Business is free for a limited time (normally 50 EGP per active seat per month).

list_themes.title: List looks and sounds
list_themes.description: List the form looks (themes) and the choices for fonts, buttons, start screens, backdrops, corner radius, layouts and sound packs (including off). Call before set_form_theme when the person asks for a style you are unsure about.

move_folder.description: Move an owned folder and its subtree to an owned parent or root. Replaces its current parent; ask for explicit relocation intent. Rejects cycles, depth above 8 and subtrees above 256 nodes. Repeating the same destination is safe, but after uncertain success reload before retrying to avoid overwriting a later move.

move_lesson_blocks.title: Move lesson blocks
move_lesson_blocks.description: Revision-protected atomic moves in supplied order. beforeId names the destination; null moves to the end. Preserves block contents and IDs; no publication.

publish_course.description: Publish the owned course and all its lessons together, with the course's visibility (lesson drafts with changes are published too). Lessons in a course can't be published on their own until the course is published; after that, publish_lesson also updates the live course. Only on explicit user request after review. Private visibility requires Business. Visibility restricted with teamId makes the course and its lessons team-only (internal): only members of that team can read them. Inspect lesson blockers when ok is false; the course remains unchanged. Repeated success creates another snapshot; do not automatically retry.

publish_flashcard_set.description: Publish the current draft as a new immutable version with the requested visibility. Only on explicit request after review. Needs at least one card. Visibility restricted with teamId makes the set team-only (internal). Returns versionId for attach_lesson_flashcards. Do not automatically retry.

publish_lesson.title: Publish a lesson
publish_lesson.description: Owner-only explicit immutable publication. Call only when asked to publish; visibility is required. Visibility restricted with teamId makes it team-only (internal): only members of that Business team can read it. A lesson in a course that isn't published yet can't be published alone: use publish_course. In a published course, this also updates the course. Validates citations, public image access and owned published assessments. Validation problems leave publication unchanged. Does not change source sharing.

publish_study_lesson.description: Publish the finalized study lesson and its native quizzes/flashcards when the user requested publication or returned profile.publish is true. Embedded quizzes and cards require public assets under existing Chaos rules, even for restricted lessons; disclose this when selecting visibility. Never changes source sharing. Source metadata/images must already have required visibility. For course lessons, refuse publication that would publish other unreviewed drafts. Safe to retry a completed job.

publish_study_source.description: Explicitly publish citation metadata (title, origin, author, license, reference URL) for an owned selected source when user-authorized. File bytes retain their existing visibility. includeImage true also makes an owned image's bytes public only when the user authorizes embedding that image in a published lesson; it is rejected for PDFs/slides/other files. Use for new source assets in an authorized publication workflow; never silently change existing source sharing. Requires publish_content permission and is safe to retry.

refresh_study_lesson_placement.description: Resume a collecting or failed study job after its course outline/modules changed. Read get_course first and send its current revision, complete ordered lesson IDs and modules. This compares the current structure and updates only the job's placement snapshot; never overwrites the course or discards teaching checkpoints. Selected module/anchor must still exist. Finalized lessons use the native course editor.

register_study_reference.description: Register metadata for a URL, video or reference the client actually consulted. This does not fetch or verify its content. Uses exact owner metadata matching to reuse prior references. Private by default; metadataVisibility public makes citation metadata public only when user-authorized. Never exposes reference file bytes or changes existing source sharing.

remember_course.description: Add a readable published course to your private learning dashboard and update its recent activity. Does not publish or enroll other people.

remove_team_member.description: Remove a member (or leave, with your own userId). Their shares to the team stop. The owner must transfer ownership before leaving. Only on explicit request.

rename_team.description: Rename a team. Owner or admin only.

restart_lesson_progress.description: Restart your own lesson reading cycle after explicit user request. Preserves previous exposure evidence, quiz responses and flashcard review history. Read get_lesson_progress first and send expectedSessionSeq; a stale session is rejected.

set_author_listing_visibility.description: Choose whether YOUR account appears in the public author carousel and directory. Only authors with public publications are listed. Hiding your listing does not unpublish content or disable direct Card links. Does not change any student's visibility.

set_course_archived.description: Archive (archived true) or restore (archived false) an owned course, like the library's archive action. Archiving hides the course from the library and its public page; lessons, drafts and published history are kept. Only on explicit request.

set_course_modules.description: Replace optional course draft modules without publishing. Read get_course first; preserve wanted modules and assignments. Each outlined lesson belongs to at most one module. Modules reference reusable owned quiz assets, not copies. Empty modules removes grouping, keeping lessons.

set_course_outline.description: Replace the complete ordered course draft outline with up to 100 owned lesson IDs. Get the course first and preserve all wanted lessons. Removing an ID does not delete the lesson. Does not publish.

set_flashcard_set_lifecycle.description: Owner-only, revision-checked: archive hides the set and stops study; restore brings it back; unpublish makes it private and removes the published pointer. History is kept and nothing is deleted. Only on explicit request.

set_form_branching.description: Explicitly replace or clear one field/ending visibility rule. Requires editor access and current draft revision. Other fields and published versions remain unchanged. Reload after uncertain success before retrying.

set_form_response_controls.description: Explicit owner-only revision-protected response configuration: access, dates, limits, one-per-person, retention, editing, hidden fields, verified email/domain rules and audienceTeamId (with signed_in access, only members of that Business team can respond: team-only forms, quizzes and their live games; null clears it). Omitted values stay unchanged; null clears dates/caps/retention. Access changes can affect existing public links. Retention can schedule data deletion. Branding removal is available on every plan.

set_form_sound.title: Turn form sounds on or off
set_form_sound.description: Choose the sound pack respondents hear while answering: soft (called Glass), pop, wood, arcade, or off for silence. Forms are silent by default; only turn sounds on when the person asks. Changes the draft; respondents hear it after publish_form.

set_form_theme.title: Change a form's look
set_form_theme.description: Change the look of a form's draft: apply a preset by name (Lilac, Banner, Paper, Evergreen, Midnight…) and/or set individual properties such as accent or background colour (hex), font, corner radius, buttons, start screen, backdrop, layout, or fixed/auto dark mode. Only what you send changes; the logo and sound are kept. Colours that are hard to read are reported in warnings. Respondents see it after publish_form.

layout.description: flat = plain page; card = questions on cards; focus = centred, one thing at a time.

appearance.description: auto adds a dark version for respondents in dark mode; fixed always uses these colours.

set_game_settings.title: Change game lobby settings
set_game_settings.description: Host-only, Pro: change a game's settings. Theme preset, question timer (5–240 s), showAnswerLabels and startWhenPlayers change only in the lobby. autoAdvance and breakSec change at any time: autoAdvance false pauses autoplay, true resumes it. Does not edit or republish the source quiz. Send at least one setting.

theme.description: Optional look by name, e.g. Lilac (default), Banner, Paper, Evergreen, Spotlight (Typeform-like), Midnight (dark). See list_themes.

timeLimitSec.description: Seconds per question; 5–240, default 20. Changes only in a lobby.

showAnswerLabels.description: Show option text on players' phones (default true). false requires a shared host screen for the options.

autoAdvance.description: Autoplay (default true): after each answer and leaderboard, move on by itself. false = the host presses Next. Can be changed during play to pause or resume.

breakSec.description: Seconds the answer, then the leaderboard, stay up during autoplay; 3–60, default 5. Can change during play.

startWhenPlayers.description: Start a 5-second countdown automatically once this many players have joined; 0 = the host starts. Lobby only.

nextStepAt.description: When autoplay moves on (ms since epoch); null when paused or not on an answer/leaderboard screen.

set_lesson_glossary.description: Add look-up definitions to a lesson the person can edit. Readers see each term highlighted and tap it for a card with the definition, translation and the meaning explained in their language, like Look Up on Apple devices. Use proactively after writing or editing a lesson: pick the technical, rare or easily confused words a learner may not know (usually 5–30) and fill translation and explanation in the learner's language (Arabic unless told otherwise). Merges by term; replace true swaps the whole list; remove deletes terms. Live at once — no publish needed and the lesson text is unchanged.

term.description: The word or phrase exactly as it appears in the lesson.

aliases.description: Other forms that appear in the text, such as plurals.

definition.description: A short plain definition in the lesson's language.

translation.description: The word in the learner's language.

explanation.description: What the word means, explained simply in the learner's language — not just a literal translation.

language.description: Language code of translation and explanation; defaults to ar.

set_lesson_lifecycle.title: Archive or unpublish a lesson
set_lesson_lifecycle.description: Owner-only revision-protected lifecycle. archive removes public access, preserving content/history; reactivate restores active state; unpublish removes the publication pointer and makes it private. No deletion or new publication.

set_student_card_preferences.description: Set YOUR global student Card visibility. Private by default; visible=true shows your Card with every teacher, visible=false hides it from all teachers' public pages. visible=true keeps individual teacher opt-outs. This is the same preference as settings and the card creation switch. Only change it when the person explicitly asks.

set_student_card_visibility.description: Choose whether YOUR real Card floats around an existing teacher's public Card, including in the authors carousel. Private by default; visible=true opts in for this teacher, visible=false opts out. A global opt-out always wins. Only change it when the person explicitly asks. Cannot expose another person's relationship or create a new one.

set_study_teaching_profile.description: Remember reusable teaching preferences as the default or for an owned course. Course preferences override defaults; per-job preferences override both. Store only the learner's requested preferences. publish true is standing authorization for future study-job publication; record it only when explicitly requested.

share_with_team.description: Share an owned form, lesson, course or folder with a team so every member can edit it. Courses include their lessons; folders include their contents. Does not publish anything or change who can read published content.

teamId.description: A Business team ID from list_teams.

unpublish_course.description: Take an owned published course offline so its public page stops working. Its lessons keep their published versions and the draft is kept; publish_course republishes. Only on explicit request.

unshare_from_team.description: Stop sharing a resource with a team. The resource owner or a team admin only.

update_course.description: Edit owned course draft metadata without publishing. Omitted fields stay unchanged; coverUrl is an https image link or a /covers/ gallery path (same gallery as lessons); null goes back to the course's default cover. coverY (0-100) is the cover's vertical focus. Icons are not shown; leave icon out. Optional details sets learning outcomes, level and estimated duration. Published metadata changes only on explicit publish_course.

update_form.title: Edit a draft
update_form.description: Change a form's draft: title, description, quiz mode, layout, or the question list. When questions is sent it replaces the whole list — questions left out are removed — so start from get_form and keep ids. Respondents keep seeing the live version until publish_form.

description.description: Intro text shown at the top.

quizMode.description: true for a scored quiz with an answer key.

showAnswers.description: Quiz mode only: after submitting, respondents see which answers were right, the correct answers and the explanations (default true). false shows only their marks, for tests whose key must stay private.

presentation.description: page = all questions on one page (default); one_at_a_time = one question per screen; sections = one page per section; swipe = full-screen cards.

id.description: Keep the id from get_form when editing an existing question; omit for new questions.

type.description: single_choice = pick one; multiple_choice = checkboxes; statement = text block with no answer; section = page break.

label.description: The question text: one short, direct sentence.

description.description: Optional help text under the question. Usually leave empty.

options.description: Choices for single_choice, multiple_choice, dropdown and ranking; columns for matrix.

min.description: scale start (0 or 1), number minimum, or minimum selections/characters.

max.description: rating steps (3–10), scale end (2–10), number maximum, or maximum selections/characters.

minLabel.description: Label for the low end of a rating or scale.

maxLabel.description: Label for the high end of a rating or scale.

correctAnswers.description: Quiz mode only: the exact label(s) of the correct option(s). One for single_choice and dropdown.

points.description: Quiz mode only: points for a correct answer (default 1).

explanation.description: Quiz mode only: one plain sentence shown after answering.

update_lesson_blocks.description: Revision-protected atomic replacement of the named existing blocks only. Each complete block's stable ID identifies the block to replace. Other blocks are preserved. Never publishes.

Raw Chaos lesson/source/version ID from Learn tools.

items.description: A Chaos block. Fields by type: paragraph, quote, toggle: text. heading: text, level 1-3. list: text, style, checked? (check style). callout: text, tone. code: text, language. diagram: text (Mermaid source), format "mermaid". equation: text (LaTeX), display. divider: none. image: sourceId, alt, caption. youtube: videoId, caption, start?, end?. table: rows, headerRows. source: sourceId, label. quiz: asset. flashcards: setId. inline (rich text runs) applies to text blocks. Fields a type does not take are dropped.

revision.description: Current revision from get_lesson; reload on conflict before retrying.

upload_study_source.description: Explicit cross-client file transfer. Send base64 chunks of at most 128 KiB decoded bytes, indexed from zero under one stable upload key. Include unchanged metadata, contentType and totalChunks on each call. Returns sourceId only after every chunk arrives and file signature is verified; partial uploads are resumable for 24 hours. Supports Chaos source MIME types and 25 MB total; no fetching local paths, client attachment IDs or arbitrary remote URLs. Files remain private. Repeated chunks must have identical bytes.

upsert_form_file_question.description: Create or update a file question in a normal form draft. Existing question order and branching are preserved; other question types cannot be replaced. Files follow Chaos upload authorization and platform limits. Requires current revision; never publishes.

add_crm_note.title: Add CRM note (admin)
add_crm_note.description: Administrators only: append a private note to an existing CRM contact and record the authenticated administrator in the audit log. The body must contain 1–5000 characters. Never sends a message to the contact. Do not retry after uncertain success; duplicate notes would be created.

complete_crm_follow_up.title: Complete CRM follow-up (admin)
complete_crm_follow_up.description: Administrators only, on explicit request: clear a contact's scheduled follow-up through the same UI action and audit it. Already completed follow-ups are unchanged. Does not send email or notifications.

get_admin_overview.title: Read platform overview (admin)
get_admin_overview.description: Administrators only: read the same aggregate platform metrics, running state and completion date shown in the administration overview. overview is null before the first refresh. Does not return individual responses.

get_crm_activity.title: Read CRM contact activity (admin)
get_crm_activity.description: Administrators only: read the latest 100 audit events for an existing contact ID returned by list_crm_contacts or get_crm_contact. Includes actor, reason and date. Does not send messages.

get_crm_contact.title: Read CRM contact (admin)
get_crm_contact.description: Administrators only: read one existing CRM contact and its latest 100 private notes. Returns the saved contact fields, linked account ID, follow-up date and note authors. Read this before replacing contact fields with save_crm_contact.

list_admin_activity.title: Read administration activity (admin)
list_admin_activity.description: Administrators only: read the latest 50 audit events shown in the admin UI, with actor, target, action, reason and date.

list_admin_content.title: List platform forms and quizzes (admin)
list_admin_content.description: Administrators only: page the same forms inventory (quizzes are quiz forms) as the admin UI, including status, owner, holds and response counts. Returns metadata only, never question content, answer keys or respondent answers.

search.description: Title words or an exact id; returns the best matches in one page.

list_admin_learning_content.title: List platform learning content (admin)
list_admin_learning_content.description: Administrators only: page courses, lessons or flashcard sets, including draft/live/archived status, title, owner name/email, dates and lesson/card count (lessons count is zero). Returns metadata only; no private lesson blocks or card answers.

list_admin_teams.title: List platform Business teams (admin)
list_admin_teams.description: Administrators only: page Business team names, owner name/email, creation dates, member counts and shared resource counts. Does not return invitations, member identities or private shared content.

list_admin_users.title: List platform accounts (admin)
list_admin_users.description: Administrators only: page through platform accounts including email, account state, suspension and moderation reason. Optional email searches the exact indexed email. Contains private account metadata; retrieve only requested accounts. Follow continueCursor until isDone.

search.description: Name, email or username words; returns the best matches in one page.

list_crm_contacts.title: List CRM contacts (admin)
list_crm_contacts.description: Administrators only: page CRM contacts with optional stage and indexed name search. followUps=true returns scheduled, non-closed contacts in ascending follow-up date order; search then matches the exact name. Contains private contact information; retrieve only what the administrator requests. Page size is bounded to 48.

list_documentation.title: List documentation (admin)
list_documentation.description: Chaos administrators only: read up to 200 draft and published guides for one language, including their current revision and blocks. Regular accounts cannot access documentation drafts or authoring.

moderate_admin_content.title: Hold or release platform content (admin)
moderate_admin_content.description: Administrators only, on explicit request: hold or release a form ID from list_admin_content. A reason is required. Holding removes public access through the same UI moderation logic and writes an audit event; releasing a hold does not republish a closed form.

moderate_admin_user.title: Moderate platform account (admin)
moderate_admin_user.description: Administrators only, on explicit request: activate, suspend or ban an account from list_admin_users. accountId is its users-table _id. A reason is required; suspension days default to 7 and must be 1–365. The same self-restriction guard, expiry scheduling and audit log as the UI apply. Changes account access immediately; do not retry after uncertain success.

refresh_admin_analytics.title: Refresh platform overview (admin)
refresh_admin_analytics.description: Administrators only: start the same asynchronous bounded platform metrics refresh as the admin UI. Read get_admin_overview afterwards to check running/completedAt. An existing recent refresh is reused.

save_crm_contact.title: Save CRM contact (admin)
save_crm_contact.description: Administrators only: create a contact, or replace its editable fields when id is supplied. Read get_crm_contact first and preserve fields the administrator did not ask to change. Omitted nextFollowUp clears the scheduled date; omitted linkedUserId unlinks the account. Dates are Unix milliseconds, email may be blank. Writes the admin audit log. Does not send email or notifications. Do not retry after uncertain success.

save_documentation.title: Author documentation (admin)
save_documentation.description: Chaos administrators only: create or update a guide. Publishes by default; set publish false when asked for a draft. When updating first read list_documentation, preserve blocks, and send expectedRevision. Slugs are lowercase hyphenated identifiers; heading ids must be unique lowercase anchors. Bold, code and links work in block text.

set_crm_contact_stages.title: Change CRM contact stages (admin)
set_crm_contact_stages.description: Administrators only, on explicit request: set one stage for 1–48 selected CRM contacts. Supports the same batch stage change as the table/pipeline UI, preserves other fields, and audits each changed contact. Never sends messages.
